about_the_game:
Breath of Life - The Vanguard






Breath of Life: The Vanguard is our first product both in the Breath of Life product line and as a third party publisher. It harkens back to a knightly class of the 3.5 edition of a very popular table-top roleplaying system, though it is not a copy-paste update. No, this is a reimagining of the class using new mechanics and systems to make it more dynamic and powerful in comparison to other non-magic classes available in the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game.
In this book you will get the following:
  • A full 1-20 level class focused on defense and battlefield control.
  • 9 archetypes to tailor your vanguard to your playstyle, like the mobile sentinel or unscrupulous mercenary captain.
  • 7 archetypes to bring vanguard mechanics and abilities to other classes like defender of the faith for the paladin or antipaladin, or tribal guardian for the barbarian and unchained barbarian.
  • New weapons to crush your foes
  • Feats to further enhance your combat style
  • An example NPC with levels in the class you can use as a guide or as an NPC to interact with your players. 
These options are guaranteed to bring some tactical combat to your table-top battlefield.
